text:
RustLabs is hiring photo retouchers and creative QA reviewers to check AI image edits against written guidelines.
 What you will do 

• Compare edited images with their instructions and spot errors

• Rate edit quality and write short, clear notes

• Work through review queues accurately and quickly

 You need 

• 1+ years of photo retouching, compositing or creative QA

• Working Photoshop skills and strong written English

 Pay and terms 

• USD 1.5 per approved task (each takes about 15 to 20 minutes), fully remote, independent contract

 How to apply 
 Click Apply and fill in our 2-minute form.
